client_mcp v0.6.5, onec-client-mcp-devkit, controlled ITL metadata revision itl-r1.
Upstream source: https://github.com/1c-neurofish/onec-client-mcp-devkit
Exact upstream commit: 3f6a066913057c2d6f2d61c0b429fd0707ab271b.
The build exports the immutable upstream release CFE to Designer XML using
the pinned 1C platform. It does not claim to compile the upstream EDT project.
ITL changes only Configuration.xml ChildObjects and adds an adopted Russian
Language without a target-base UUID binding. Modules and resources are retained.
The corresponding-source ZIP contains the complete patched Designer XML source,
source identity, controlled manifest, repair metadata, rebuild instructions,
upstream license and the GNU GPL incorporated by that license.
No runtime artifact patching or installed-copy replacement is used.
